facts.fact: Gabon is piloting GIMACPAY's interoperable QR-code payment system through the national programme MADIGIPAIE, according to Biometric Update.
Gabon already has substantial mobile money use, according to Biometric Update.
MADIGIPAIE QR payments let customers pay across participating financial institutions, covering more than 3,273 merchants and 1,382 GIMAC QR codes as of July, authorities said.

GAB.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
